description: Output quality eval: verify ue-explain produces comprehensive explanations with hierarchy, MCP tool usage, and code examples

assertions.description: Should reference ACharacter in the explanation

assertions.criteria: Does the response explain ACharacter's class hierarchy or parent classes (e.g., APawn, AActor, UObject)? It should mention inheritance or parent class relationships.
assertions.description: Should include class hierarchy or parent class information (LLM judge)

assertions.criteria: Does the response explain ACharacter's movement system or CharacterMovementComponent? It should describe how characters move, walk, jump, or use movement components.
assertions.description: Should explain core ACharacter movement system (LLM judge)

assertions.criteria: Does the response address BP_Player in any meaningful way? This includes: attempting to find the asset, reporting it was not found, describing what a Player Blueprint typically is, suggesting alternatives, or providing any relevant Blueprint information. Even a 'not found' response with context counts as meeting the criteria.
assertions.description: Should address BP_Player query meaningfully, even if asset not found (LLM judge)
Should provide an overview of the Gameplay Ability System
Should include key GAS class/function names or concepts
Should reference Enhanced Input system concepts
Should explain key Enhanced Input concepts
